source_cards.title: Force and velocity measured for single kinesin molecules
source_cards.primary_anchor: Cell 77:773–784; Summary; Fig. 9; Experimental Procedures; extracted text lines 19–29, 434–480, 851–872

conditions.motor: Purified squid optic-lobe kinesin; nominal single molecule per bead

source_cards.observational_unit: Bead trajectories corrected for linkage compliance. Multiple runs per bead are not independent cells.
source_cards.finding: Maximum opposing forces about 5–6 pN and condition-dependent force–velocity curves support an approximate kinesin scale.
source_cards.limits: No universal human isoform, cellular census, or common exponential transition force scale follows.

source_cards.title: Force production by single kinesin motors
source_cards.primary_anchor: Nature Cell Biology 2:718–723; Figs. 2–4; Eq. 6; Methods/Analysis; PDF pages 3–5

conditions.motor: Single kinesin-coated 0.5 um glass bead; species/construct not restated in brief Methods
conditions.temperature: Not restated; earlier protocols referenced but not imported as a measured condition here
conditions.ATP: Variable; force curves at 5 uM and 2 mM

source_cards.observational_unit: Velocity data reused from Visscher 1999; Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 have different run counts.
source_cards.finding: Fig. 2: kcat0 = 103 ± 2/s and velocity-fit distance 3.7 ± 0.3 nm. Fig. 3: A = 107 ± 9 cycles and processivity-fit distance 1.3 ± 0.1 nm. Means ± SEM.
source_cards.limits: No direct universal zero-load koff = 1/s located. Fit parameters are not microstate off-rates. Finite-detector correction assumes exponential run lengths. Proposed substeps do not measure primed_fraction. The paper studies kinesin.

source_cards.title: Kinesin hydrolyses one ATP per 8-nm step
source_cards.primary_anchor: Nature 388:386–390; Figs. 1–3; Methods p. 389; local PDF pages 1–4

conditions.motor: Squid optic-lobe kinesin; single-molecule bead assay
conditions.temperature: Not explicitly restated in inspected Methods
conditions.ATP: 0.75, 1, 2 uM for resolved step intervals; velocity over three decades

source_cards.observational_unit: Corrected bead trajectories; statistical stepping, dwell and fluctuation analysis.
source_cards.finding: Near-zero-load 8 nm centroid advance is associated with one ATP. Fig. 1 fitted saturation velocity 680 ± 31 nm/s, means ± SEM.
source_cards.limits: Centroid advance differs from each head displacement. It is not a fixed dynein step or model node-walk measurement.

source_cards.title: Mechanical properties of single motor molecules studied by three-dimensional thermal force probing in optical tweezers
source_cards.primary_anchor: ChemPhysChem 5:1150–1158; Fig. 5/p. 1155; construct p. 1151; Experimental Section p. 1157

conditions.motor: Full-length Drosophila kinesin mutant missing one head, still dimerizing
conditions.geometry: 430 nm silica bead; tether-axis thermal fluctuations

source_cards.observational_unit: Second derivative of tether free energy; extension-dependent response of the measured linkage.
source_cards.finding: About 0.3 pN/nm in stretching and 0.05 pN/nm in compression; similar order of magnitude across 100 experiments.
source_cards.limits: Not an isolated uniform stalk constant or uncertainty band on 0.3. One-headed rigor binding does not establish an actively walking motor or dynein parameter.

source_cards.title: Submolecular domains of bovine brain kinesin identified by electron microscopy and monoclonal antibody decoration

conditions.assay: Rotary-shadowing EM; separate quick-freeze/deep-etch MT-bead geometry

source_cards.observational_unit: Isolated molecular lengths and MT-bead attachments.
source_cards.finding: Official abstract: about 80 nm rod length; MT–microsphere arms 25–30 nm.
source_cards.limits: Rod length, head–cargo separation and capture radius differ. Likely 2009 review identity is recorded separately; its connection to this primary source is not proven.

source_cards.title: Crystal structure of the dynein motor domain
source_cards.primary_anchor: Science 331:1159–1165; Structure Determination; Fig. 1; extracted text lines 5, 8–10, 81

conditions.motor: S. cerevisiae GST-dimerized truncated motor domains
conditions.structure: 6 angstrom crystal; MTBD and part of stalk removed
conditions.ATP: Structural context, not a walking ATP series

source_cards.observational_unit: Crystallized construct dimensions and domain arrangement.

source_cards.title: The mammalian dynein–dynactin complex is a strong opponent to kinesin in a tug-of-war competition
source_cards.primary_anchor: Nature Cell Biology 18:1018–1024; Fig. 2d,e; Methods/Optical trap assay; extracted text lines 16–18, 30–32, 93

conditions.motor: Recombinant human DYNC1H1 six-subunit complex; pig-brain dynactin; mouse BICD2N(1–400)
conditions.temperature: Assay temperature not located; 27°C describes Sf9 expression
conditions.geometry: 860 nm latex bead via BICD2N-GFP; sea-urchin axonemes

source_cards.observational_unit: Stalls nested within beads and experiments.
source_cards.finding: Fig. 2d DDB: 4.3 ± 0.2 pN SEM; 45 stalls, 14 beads, 4 experiments. Fig. 2e kinesin: 5.8 ± 0.1 pN SEM; 37 stalls, 15 beads, 4 experiments.
source_cards.limits: Complex, track and attachment geometry matter. Different assay from yeast P08, not a direct contradiction. Force histograms do not give intracellular motor copy counts.

source_cards.title: Activation of cytoplasmic dynein motility by dynactin-cargo adapter complexes
source_cards.primary_anchor: Science 345:337–341; Fig. 1G,H; main text paragraph 6; Fig. S2E mentioned; extracted text lines 5–7, 52

conditions.motor: Pig-brain DDB isolated with GFP-BicD2N; human RPE-derived DDB is a separate preparation
conditions.temperature: Separate 37°C condition reported in Fig. S2E; baseline not verified from supporting Methods
conditions.ATP: Main text 2 mM versus Fig. 1G legend 1 mM; unresolved
conditions.load: Unloaded TIRF complex motion; MT gliding is a separate assay

source_cards.observational_unit: Fig. 1G/H share 379 processive molecules from two preparations; raw row pairing not exposed.
source_cards.finding: Velocity 376 ± 218 nm/s, mean ± SD. Run length 8.7 um from an exponential fit. Separate 37°C velocity 892 nm/s.
source_cards.limits: Species, temperature and complex prevent universal contradiction of 1 um/s. ATP discrepancy requires resolution. Equal n does not establish paired data or covariance.

source_cards.title: Adaptor-mediated recruitment of three dyneins to dynactin enhances force generation
source_cards.primary_anchor: Nature Cell Biology 28:480–491; Fig. 1b–d; Fig. 6; Optical-tweezers Methods; official workbook; correction DOI 10.1038/s41556-026-01918-8

conditions.motor: Fig. 1 rat-brain DDB via BicD2(25–400)-sfGFP; later recombinant human assays are distinct
conditions.ATP: 2 mM trapping; 100 uM ATPgammaS for separate three-colour assay
conditions.geometry: 0.52 um anti-GFP or 0.55 um streptavidin beads; immobilized MTs

source_cards.observational_unit: Repeated stall plateaus within traces/beads; class histograms and force-binned kinematics.
source_cards.finding: Fig. 1c Gaussian-fit means 2.48, 4.60, 7.10, 9.10 pN; SEM 0.04, 0.02, 0.02, 0.05; n 59, 153, 231, 34. Source-column counts match.
source_cards.limits: Motor-number assignments depend on authors’ interpretation and separate assays. They are not directly observed head counts for every stall. Fig. 3a,b fourth-column labels were corrected 2 March 2026.

relations.statement: L=v/koff is a restricted mapping, not proof that these three declarations were independently measured.
assumptions: Same motor complex and experimental conditions
Memoryless constant detachment hazard; unresolved pauses, rebinding, selection and censoring handled
Distance and lifetime definitions consistent; a two-substate node walker need not inherit the identity exactly
relations.evidence: TM02 shows run-length censoring correction and condition dependence. No numerical rate adopted.

relations.statement: Frozen code walks one MT node and sets rates v/(spacing*f), v/(spacing*(1-f)). Only static mean-cycle arithmetic is inspected. v=d*r requires fixed forward increments and compatible pause/backstep definitions. Head, dimer-centroid and cargo displacements are separate observables.

Frozen code uses stall_force as the exponential walking-transition and detachment force scale. The walking transition remains positive at finite force; the reprime transition is not force-scaled there. This differs from the definition of an experimentally measured zero-velocity stall.
relations.proposal: PI/owner review of observation-to-input mapping. No model change.

relations.statement: TM02 Figs. 2/3 share load/ATP conditions but have different n and separate fit parameters. No same-run join or covariance recovered. Shared citation cannot supply one.
TM08 Fig. 1G/H both have n=379. Raw trace identities and censoring could support paired observations, but marginal summaries alone do not. ATP discrepancy remains unresolved.

TM09 workbook contains force-binned steps, dwells, linkage stiffness and velocity. Stable cross-sheet trace IDs are not established. DDB classes are not observed head-count labels. Retain paper/condition/trace hierarchy and quarantine pending parser, owner and source audit.
